title: Is breakfast the most important meal of the day?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Do you personally function better after eating breakfast, or can you comfortably skip it?
Why do people disagree so strongly about whether breakfast is essential?
Should schools provide breakfast for students who arrive without eating?
Does the quality of breakfast matter more than simply eating something?
Would you change your breakfast habits if strong evidence showed they affected concentration?
